events.title: High-tide flooding reaches the waterfront
events.summary: Seawater flooded part of the Embarcadero during abnormally high tides, restricting access along the waterfront.
events.why_it_matters: A useful real-world reference point for the season: coastal impacts depend on the combined water level, not on one ocean process alone.
events.caveat: This log does not attribute this incident to a Kelvin wave. High astronomical tides, elevated coastal water, swell, weather, and local Bay conditions can overlap.
